name: edgrapi-skills
description: Agent skills for US government data (SAM.gov, USAspending, Grants.gov, congressional trades) and SEC EDGAR financials, plus a hosted MCP server, via Edgrapi.com
author: Edgrapi

skills.name: edgrapi-full
skills.description: Complete toolkit across all five sources — SAM.gov contract opportunities, USAspending awards, Grants.gov funding, US House STOCK Act trades, plus SEC EDGAR fundamentals, ratios, company profiles and filings.

skills.name: edgrapi-gov
skills.description: US federal procurement, spending and grants — SAM.gov contract opportunities, USAspending awards, Grants.gov funding, and US House STOCK Act stock trades, normalized to one JSON schema.

skills.name: edgrapi-fundamentals
skills.description: Normalized financial statements and computed ratios (margins, returns, leverage, liquidity) for a ticker, parsed from SEC EDGAR XBRL.

skills.name: edgrapi-filings
skills.description: Company profiles (CIK, industry, fiscal-year end, exchange) and recent SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K) with document links.
